messages.text: I’m checking the fresh 20k results against the local arrays and frozen models, then reviewing all nine figures and the uncertainty interpretation.

**ECAL-HIGHSTAT-PHYSVAL-FINAL**, reviewed **83eb6a8828eea3cfd54da07650ca226a88f7c2e9**. **No material scientific or implementation finding.**

Actual checks passed:

- Reproduced all six frozen-inference series and **438 population summaries**, including all **120 inclusive angular histograms**, energy/control tables, tails, RMS, clipping and extrapolation.
- Confirmed **84 zeros** remain throughout.
- Both covariance sets have the expected width rank **80** and correct contrast transformation; maximum \(A\Sigma A^\mathsf{T}\) discrepancy **5.8×10⁻¹⁹**.
- Checked **1,680 interval diagnostics**, 120 contrast diagnostics, all 27 render hashes and all twelve batch provenance chains covering **120,000 events / 76,941,173 hits**.
- Visually inspected all nine PNG families.

The interpretation is appropriately limited. Spline width improves **31.322→30.209%** against the retrained linear comparator, while global mean **1.00300** coexists with substantial local bias, seam widths **73–75%**, a **9.38%** half-energy tail and **8.79%** gain clipping. The stated **17/20** positive angular contrast ranges are pointwise.

Bootstrap centering diagnostics show no analogous large shift to the exploratory learning-curve case; the largest angular-width mean offset is **0.16 bootstrap SD**. Coverage nevertheless remains approximate, especially with 200 full refits.

No retuning, writes, simulation or publication. Full bootstrap generation and ROOT readback were not repeated; their source and realized bindings were reviewed. This assessment grants no detector acceptance or sign-off.
